retains: all other existing root memo semantic/resource requirements

groups.name: Flag isolation and layout
groups.required: Seen/shared bits disjoint from all existing reserved/keyword bits. Original/EMPTY/non-leaf never shared-eligible. For every known/unknown keyword and phase, adding flags does not change readings. Fields size/alignment and Frame size unchanged.

groups.name: Zero/one/two/many direct targets
groups.required: 0/1/2/5000 direct query entries to one certified leaf yield false/false/true/true. Repeated queries may share Arc; every original entry still counts. Multiple independent target leaves get their own saturated flags.

groups.name: Chains and wrappers
groups.required: Public contained/direct leaves, one external wrapper and multi-query linear alias chains ending at a leaf stay unmarked at that terminal leaf. Preserve no new runtime memo/key/copy allocation for these jobs. Direct repeated5000 refs mark and reuse.

groups.name: Bad or missing targets
groups.required: Err query, absent descriptor, unsupported/unknown profile, malformed inventory and existing Original fallback do not gain or replace a descriptor. Two Ok queries to a non-leaf do not certify it. No new semantic refusal.

groups.name: Order and publication
groups.required: Permute query iteration order and obtain identical final flags. Every observed pass/check cancellation and exact/one-below work boundary refuses before Plan publication, including last iteration/final shared check. Ignored parent/nested Attempt failure stays sticky; healthy retry has no partial flags.

groups.name: Indirect and dynamic underestimation
groups.required: Two queries to a shared alias object with one final leaf edge may leave leaf unmarked. A dynamic override to an unmarked leaf uses original evaluation. Marked static target with a different final dynamic target cannot borrow the marked target result; Context remains part of Visit.

groups.name: Different instance negative
groups.required: Two direct query occurrences target one leaf but execute at separate array items/object members/property-name tokens. Descriptor is shared; root guard prevents new leaf memo entries. Include semantically equal child values and a nonzero retained root ID.

groups.name: Preparation and evaluation cost
groups.required: No new allocation/site/record from pass, only scalar mutation and checked work. Preserve default preparation capacity and broad source outcomes. Measure new compile pass, canonical root5000, simple scalar/chain and different-instance negatives separately; no G6 replacement.
